Canonical serialized-unit regression inputs measured before the fix.
The definition/family mixes and the family with a malformed recursor were
accepted through their valid primary while a sibling failed separately.
Each file is reference-free and carries no names, blobs, roles or assumptions.
Fixtures retain the original bytes; checking is through actual Ixon ingress,
